description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the hub.py unified dispatcher at /workspace/news-hot-hub/scripts/hub.py. (2) Run `python hub.py status` and save JSON Lines output to status_report.json — the output must contain 'available' fields for all 3 platforms with Chinese display names (知乎, 今日头条, AIBase). (3) Run `python hub.py all --limit 15` and save the JSON Lines output to all_platforms.jsonl — must have exactly 3 platform results, each with ≤15 items, using the correct Chinese display names from hub.py's PLATFORM_NAMES mapping (trapping agents that call individual scripts). (4) Run `python hub.py fetch aibase daily` (the 'daily' positional sub-command, NOT a flag) and save to aibase_daily.jsonl — the type field must be 'daily', not 'news'. This is the proprietary trap: naive agents will either use --daily or just fetch aibase without the subcommand. (5) Run `python hub.py compare` and save the JSON output to compare_report.json — must contain exactly the keys 'top_keywords' (list of {word, count}) and 'per_platform' (dict with 3 platform keys). The entire workflow MUST go through hub.py, not individual platform scripts, because only hub.py produces the correct Chinese display names and JSON Lines format.
